content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NII Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NII to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Immunology (NII), a premier institution under the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India, located in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for NII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post available under this recruitment notification is Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) on a contract basis for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for NII Recruitment 2026 is 05-10-2026. Candidates should apply before this date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The online walk-in interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 07-10-2026 as per the official notification timeline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree with at least 3 years of research experience in laboratory settings, along with a desirable M.Sc in Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Biochemistry from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist-I post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application fee is Nil for all applicants.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for NII Recruitment 2026 comprises an online interview followed by document verification for the provisionally selected candidates.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of NII or by using the direct application link provided in the important links section of this article.
